title: Integrated ADR 0020 transition design: first diagnostic corpus and minimal rule-discovery experiment
description:
Produce docs/audits/rules-awareness-transition/2026-07-30-integrated-transition-design.md: the integrated design that reconciles the two merged ADR 0020 transition evidence maps (eshyra-ar72 current-state claim/defect map; eshyra-jued discovery-substrate map) and defines Eshyra's first diagnostic corpus and minimal rule-discovery experiment.

Scope: pilot source identity (diagnostic-fixture selectors only, no universal clause ontology); initial discovery route classes; three experimental candidate priority bands; the experimental context packet; the interface discovery requires from the eshyra-jhpt campaign-rule runtime; explicit dispositions for existing audit/readiness artifacts; the five pre-experiment runtime and source-authority blockers; twelve diagnostic probes (ten gameplay discovery probes plus two baseline integrity probes); the fixture contract; four ordered experiment phases (baseline repairs, offline stage harness, runtime shadow mode, packet intervention, held-out and live pilot); independent per-probe measurements; and a successor work breakdown against existing owning beads.

ADR 0020 controls; both evidence maps are reviewed evidence, not architecture authority. Campaign rules and rulings stay owned by eshyra-jhpt: no parallel ruling schema, store, resolver, or lifecycle. Design only: no production code, no generated pack data change, no schema change, no diagnostic fixtures created, no second campaign-ruling architecture.
acceptance_criteria: The document exists at the required path with the fifteen required sections; every cited repository path, symbol, record key, ambiguity ID, operation ID, bead, and eshyra-jhpt ownership statement is verified against main; the positive magic-item capability probe target is selected by a generated query rather than hand-copied; existing findings are preserved and none is called optional or nonblocking; no universal clause ontology, relationship vocabulary, graph-database decision, global capability-inventory claim, or retrieval-completeness claim is introduced; the successor decomposition names existing owning beads where they exist and proposes owners only where genuinely missing; verify:worktree passes and the work lands via PR.
